findings.problem: The Problem Statement still says the package must prove which gate actually blocked a problem, while the Gate event protocol explicitly permits a no-blocking run and supplies language that refuses to claim any interception.
findings.remedy: Reword the second Problem Statement promise to require evidence of whether a blocking event occurred, including the explicit no-blocking case.

findings.problem: P1-P6 and especially P5 remain undefined as concrete decisions. The Premises list does not map its six entries to those identifiers, so references to verifying or retaining P5 cannot be understood from this document alone.
findings.remedy: Add a compact P1-P6 mapping or spell out P5 explicitly at each reference.

findings.problem: The artifact map still lists post-build.md as a minimum artifact, while the Success Criteria allow P5 to remain UNVERIFIED when no post-build independent observation exists. No rule says whether post-build.md must contain an explicit UNVERIFIED record or may be absent and explained by the index.
findings.remedy: Require post-build.md to contain an explicit UNVERIFIED record when no eligible learner is available, or mark it conditional in the artifact map and require the evidence index to explain its absence.

findings.problem: The Assignment requires a pre-spec learner observation before entering spec, but Next Steps proceeds from freezing evidence directly to writing SPEC.md and lists only the post-build observation later. A reader following Next Steps can skip the required pre-spec checkpoint and its record.
findings.remedy: Add an explicit pre-spec learner checkpoint before the spec step, including creation of the UNVERIFIED record when no learner is available.

prior.evidence: The Success Criteria now require the post-build learner to be different from the pre-spec observer, not to have participated in the build, and not previously to have seen the design or evidence package; they also require eligibility to be recorded and forbid using the result when independence cannot be confirmed. The Assignment additionally records a participant alias or identifier and forbids reusing the pre-spec participant for post-build.md.
The Problem Statement still says the package must show which gate actually blocked a problem, while the Gate event protocol permits and defines honest language for a run with no blocking event.
The Decision Gate Resolution still lists P1-P6 as approved without mapping them to concrete premises, and later passages still refer to P5 without defining it.

The artifact map still lists post-build.md as a minimum artifact, while the Success Criteria allow a missing independent observation to leave P5 UNVERIFIED; no explicit rule fixes whether the file must exist or may be absent.
The Assignment still requires the pre-spec learner observation before entering spec, but Next Steps still moves directly from freezing evidence to writing SPEC.md and lists only the post-build check.
